notes.title: Let’s rock! Five Devil May Cry music albums just launched on Steam!
notes.content:
Just like a perfectly timed Judgement Cut, today we’re following up on Vergil’s arrival by releasing some additional content on Steam, in the form of awesome head-bangin’ [i]Devil May Cry[/i] music albums!

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426650/Devil_May_Cry_Original_Soundtrack/]Devil May Cry Original Soundtrack[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426670/Devil_May_Cry_2_Original_Soundtrack/]Devil May Cry 2 Original Soundtrack[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426680/Devil_May_Cry_3_Original_Soundtrack/]Devil May Cry 3 Original Soundtrack[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426690/Devil_May_Cry_4_Original_Soundtrack/]Devil May Cry 4 Original Soundtrack[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426710/Devil_May_Cry_HRHM_Arrange/]Devil May Cry HR/HM Arrange[/url]
[/list]

For the uninitiated, Steam now has a section of their store dedicated to music. This is most commonly used for soundtracks of games available on Steam (and you’ll find the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1050460/Devil_May_Cry_5_Original_Soundtrack/]Devil May Cry 5 OST[/url] there as well!), but it’s also open to any music release… hence [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426710/Devil_May_Cry_HRHM_Arrange/]Devil May Cry HR/HM Arrange]Devil May Cry HR/HM Arrange[/url]. It’s one hell of an album, so we definitely recommend checking it out.

The soundtracks come with MP3 (V0 bitrate), FLAC (16-bit), and AAC (Variable bitrate) music files. Ownership of the base [i]Devil May Cry HD Collection[/i] or [i]Devil May Cry 4: Special Edition[/i] game is not required to purchase these soundtracks.

Get over to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/capcom/list/37726/]curated list of Capcom Original Soundtracks on Steam[/url] and buy some of your favorite soundtracks – and find some new favorites while you’re there!

Alright, enough from us. Between Vergil and these rockin’ tunes, you’ve got enough to juggle today. Keep it SSStylish!
